verdict: DOES NOT GENERALISE to a novel protein: AUROC 0.210 on held-out proteins against 0.763 on a random split. MMP-9 is absent from this corpus, so an in-silico SELEX driven by this model would be ranking 40-mers by something other than MMP-9 binding. The corpus has only ~144 distinct proteins, which is the likely cause -- this is a data limitation, not a modelling bug.
